protocol.memory_rule: heldout one support image excluded; remaining three clean support images only
protocol.query_rule: heldout clean, nine synthetic episodes, and five fixed nuisance strength-0 queries
protocol.nuisance_selection: one fixed strength-0 variant per family; no result-dependent choice
protocol.quantization: memory-only; symmetric per-channel INT8 scale max(abs(memory[:,c]))/127; round-to-nearest; query remains float32
